chunks.text_en: Always by the Window, We Are. It's always funny how everyone loves someone and is loved back. Third High School Series Vol. 1: It must be a fantasy. It's always funny how everyone loves someone and is loved back, in the window seat of Class 2-6 at Third High School. The second floor of the school building, with a view of the schoolyard from the window. The season could be summer, winter, or somewhere in between. If it's summer, the sky is clear without a cloud; if it's winter, it’s snowing. But maybe it’s the other way around. Several school desks are lined up from stage left to stage right. A curtain hangs at the back of the stage, swaying slightly in the breeze. It’s currently lunchtime. Shiroko is sitting in the center or slightly to the right, sleeping with her head down. On the left, Mari and Ruri-iro are whispering while hiding behind the curtain. Then, Niina appears. For some reason, Niina is strangely concerned about Shiroko, who is sleeping by the window. Occasionally, laughter can be heard from the two behind the curtain. Hee hee hee. Someone's footsteps sound three times: tap tap tap, tap tap tap, tap tap tap. Niina sits behind Shiroko, staring intently at her back. Shiroko's neck is slightly damp with sweat. Niina looks at her neck and remembers her grandmother, who also used to sweat a lot on her neck. When she was young, Niina often had her grandmother carry her on her back. However, she always felt that the sweat on her neck was dirty, so she would tilt her head back to avoid touching her grandmother's neck. Because of that, her neck always hurt after being carried. Still, Niina never refused her grandmother's offer. Her grandmother passed away last month. Niina looks up at the ceiling. Ruri-iro comes out from behind the curtain and runs out of the classroom. Laughter comes again from behind the curtain. Hee hee hee. Niina glances toward the curtain. Niina pulls out her iPhone and headphones.
